_note: Servo profiles. configs/robot.json picks one ('servo_profile'). Every value has a status: published (with link), derived (with formula), assumed. docs/model_card.md lists them all.

_sources.seller: https://openelab.io/products/feetech-sts3215-c018-servo-12v (spec table for the C018; 'Product Comparison' table for the C001 7.4 V)

sts3215_7v4.what: Feetech STS3215-C001, 7.4 V, 345:1. The measured reference profile (BAM / Open Duck).
sts3215_7v4.profile_status: published (measured by BAM, used by Open Duck)

damping_Nm_s_per_rad.source: open_duck: joint damping="0.56" (= BAM back-EMF kt^2/R = 1.178^2/2.479 = 0.559)

backlash_deg.source: open_duck: class 'backlash', range +-0.008727 rad (+-0.5 deg); seller: gear backlash <= 0.5 deg

stall_torque_Nm.source: seller: C001 stall 19.5 kg.cm at 7.4 V (x 0.0980665)

rated_torque_Nm.source: seller: C001 rated 5 kg.cm at 7.4 V

deadband_deg.source: one encoder step (360/4096); the firmware dead-zone setting is not checked

sts3215_12v.what: Feetech STS3215-C018, 12 V, 345:1. DERIVED, NOT MEASURED: the 7.4 V model scaled to the seller's 12 V figures. The default profile (D19).
sts3215_12v._formula: s_tau = stall_12 / stall_7.4 = 30 / 19.5 = 1.5385;  s_w = speed_12 / speed_7.4 = (0.192 s) / (0.222 s) = 0.8649.  kp, forcerange x s_tau;  damping x s_tau / s_w (so that top speed ~ forcerange / damping scales by s_w);  frictionloss, armature, backlash unchanged (same 345:1 gearbox: assumed)

stall_torque_Nm.source: seller: C018 stall 30 kg.cm at 12 V

rated_torque_Nm.source: seller: C018 rated 10 kg.cm at 12 V

spt5435_guess.what: SPT5435LV PWM hobby servo (the reference design's servo). Seller figures only; kept for comparison. One speed limit: forcerange = stall, damping = stall / no-load speed, no rate limiter.

kp_Nm_per_rad.source: full stall torque at 5 deg error (3.4 / 0.0873)

forcerange_Nm.source: = stall (seller, 6.0 V); the old 0.7 margin is dropped: with it the top speed was 0.7 x 7.48 = 5.2 rad/s

armature_kg_m2.source: reflected motor + gear inertia at the output

stall_torque_Nm.source: seller spec at 6.0 V (Stage 1 prompt), not checked

rated_torque_Nm.source: 25 % of stall (sustained-load guide); the seller gives no continuous rating

deadband_deg.source: 4 us of the 500-2500 us range x 180 deg / 2000 us

mass_g.source: sellers say 62-72 g. NOT used by the model: the mass table uses the default profile's 55 g for every profile (model card, known limits)
